title: Practice: Spinning Back Elbow
source: Practice Mode tutorial. The move is in the app's Technique Library (practiceData.js › Muay Thai › Spinning Back Elbow: cues, mistakes, next), named from the owner's footage by Claude; the owner corrects the name at approval. Thai: Sok Klap (ศอกกลับ). Footage: the owner's clip 1 (ring, 2026-10-31), raw-footage/practice/p1.mp4. One shot; three spins, the elbow landing at about 2.1, 5.2 and 7.9 s.

props.hookSub: Spinning back elbow. Sok Klap. 20 seconds.

cues.text: Step across to start the turn
cues.label: STEP ACROSS
cues.say: Coach: "The lead foot crosses over. That step is what starts the spin."

cues.text: Spot the target over your shoulder
cues.label: SPOT
cues.say: Coach: "Head turns first. Find them over your shoulder before the elbow comes."

cues.text: Whip the elbow through on the turn
cues.label: WHIP
cues.say: Coach: "The hips turn and the elbow rides the turn. Don't throw it, let the spin throw it."

watch.label: BLIND
watch.say: Coach: "Spin without looking and you eat a counter. Eyes first, elbow second."

props.alias: ศอกกลับ · SOK KLAP
